card_line: Mars rules you both, so you both go after what you want. Great if you like a bold match.
s21_body: Aries and Scorpio share Mars, the planet of drive. You both make the first move. Aim that energy at the same plans, not at winning arguments.

card_line: Venus rules you both, so romance comes naturally. Great if you love classic, well planned dates.
s21_body: Taurus and Libra share Venus, the planet of love. You both love beauty, comfort and a well planned evening. Book the nice restaurant, it will be worth it.

card_line: Mercury rules you both, so the talk never runs dry. Great if conversation is everything to you.
s21_body: Gemini and Virgo share Mercury, the planet of talking. Expect long conversations and very good texts. Pick a date where you can actually hear each other.

card_line: Jupiter rules you both: big plans and adventure. Great if you want a partner to explore with.
s21_body: Sagittarius and Pisces share Jupiter, the planet of growth. You both want adventure and meaning. Plan a date that feels like a small trip.

card_line: Saturn rules you both, so you both take love seriously. Strong pick if you want commitment.
s21_body: Capricorn and Aquarius share Saturn, the planet of commitment. You both show up and follow through. Slow to start, very hard to break.
